jobs.description:
Context & Environment

HR Administration Specialist – with strong experience in payroll and event administration

Full-time | Copenhagen

Start date: As soon as possible

Application deadline: 07 December 2026

Appetizer

If you take pride in accurate payroll, well-organised HR administration and getting the practical details right, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for an HR Administration Specialist who enjoys structure, takes ownership and likes being the person colleagues can rely on. You will combine payroll and HR administration with systems, compliance and the practical coordination of meetings and seminars across our Nordic organisation.

About the organisation

You will join TotalEnergies Marketing & Services Nordic Hub in Copenhagen, working with colleagues across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

You will join a small Nordic HR team where we work closely together, support each other and value great service.

What will you be doing?

A key part of your role will be payroll and HR administration, taking ownership of recurring processes and ensuring they are completed accurately and on time.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing Nordic payroll administration and coordinating with external payroll providers. This also includes absence management.

• Preparing employment contracts and managing onboarding and offboarding including ensuring efficient set-up in systems e.g.

• Administering pension, insurance, benefits, absence and employee data

• Maintaining accurate employee records and HR systems

• Supporting audits, GDPR and compliance

• Maintaining HR procedures, policies and the Nordic employee handbook

• Acting as administrator and super user for our HR systems

• Supporting suppliers, purchase orders and administrative workflows in SAP

• Finding practical ways to simplify and improve recurring processes

There is also a people and communication side

You will be responsible for the practical coordination of our annual seminars and Nordic Hub meetings and other internal events, managing everything from venues and invitations to participant communication and logistics.

We are looking for someone who enjoys planning, attention to detail and creating a welcoming, well-organized workplace.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

• Has at least 3 years of relevant HR administration, payroll or HR operations experience, including proven hands-on payroll experience. Applicants without payroll experience will not be considered.

• Genuinely enjoys administrative work, recurring processes and getting the details right

• Is structured, accurate and dependable

• Enjoys organizing meetings, seminars and events

• Is comfortable working across different IT systems and genuinely enjoys learning new ones

• Is approachable, proactive and enjoys helping colleagues

• Handles confidential information with discretion and professionalism

You must be fluent in English and speak either Danish or Swedish at native level.

What we offer

This is a role where administrative excellence is valued, and where you can build deep expertise in Nordic HR administration, payroll, systems and compliance.

We also offer:

• An international and diverse Nordic workplace

• Up to 3 days a year of voluntary work during working hours

• Flexibility and the opportunity to work from home

• An attractive employee share scheme

• A bright and welcoming Copenhagen office with freshly baked bread for breakfast and delicious lunch facilities

• A strong sense of community and a variety of social events throughout the year

Application and contact

If you enjoy being the person who keeps things organized, accurate and moving, we would be happy to hear from you.

Please apply by 07 December 2026. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews may take place before the deadline.

For questions, please contact HR Manager Pernille HESSELBY at pernille.hesselby@totalenergies.com.

Give your best to better energy and make the commitment with TotalEnergies. jobs.occupation: Senior Environment Advisor – Environmental Impact Assessments
jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Application deadline: 03-12-2026 We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Contract type: Local

Job location: Esbjerg or Copenhagen (with 2 days per week in Esbjerg)

Appetizer

Do you want to shape how responsible energy development is done in Denmark, not just comment on it? Can you turn complex environmental science into approvals that keep major projects moving? Do you thrive when regulators, consultants and project teams need one person who brings them together?

At TotalEnergies EP Danmark, we are looking for an experienced Senior Environment Advisor to help protect the marine environment and keep our licence to operate strong, supporting everything from minor changes to major developments in the Danish North Sea.

In this role, you will manage Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) documentation from preparation through regulatory approval, working with project teams, senior management and external consultants. If you enjoy complex assessments, cross‑disciplinary collaboration, and shaping high‑profile projects from early planning to approval, this could be your next step.

You will be part of a supportive, collaborative team where psychological safety is valued, and trust is at the core of how we work together.

If you recognise yourself in these questions, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!

Activities

Key responsibilities

• Manage the preparation and submission of EIA documentation, prepared by an impartial third party, for projects ranging from minor changes to major developments related to extraction of oil and gas, CO2 injection, decommissioning of platforms etc., in line with the requirements of the competent authorities (DEA, or DEPA for onshore projects).

• Oversee and collaborate with external consultants on larger ‘Environmental Impact Screening’ and ‘Environmental and Social Impact Assessment’ documentation, technically reviewing drafts and coordinating final completion for submission to the regulator.

• Communicate with regulatory authorities, coordinate EIA documentation through the approval process, and revise documents in response to regulator and stakeholder comments.

• Communicate with stakeholders and respond to environmental issues that may arise.

• Communicate with project team members, participate in project progress meetings, and integrate environmental requirements into project delivery.

• Advise and integrate with senior management on environmental project delivery and performance.

• Collaborate with HQ (Paris), other TotalEnergies affiliates, and environmental colleagues to develop environmental and biodiversity information for EIAs, environmental performance reporting, and environmental management.

• Provide environmental technical support to ENV team peers on EIA documentation, and support wider ENV and HSE activities as directed.

• Provide technical input into key documents and procedures upon request, as identified in the TEPDK HSE Management System.

• Communicate the importance of the EIA process to the wider TEPDK audience (e.g., through presentations).

Candidate Profile

What are we looking for in a candidate

• Minimum 10 years of experience in environmental impact assessments (EIA) and environmental management, including planning, coordinating, preparing and reviewing EIA’s for offshore development projects in the marine environment, from the beginning until authority approval

• University degree in a technical field, preferably Environmental Science, Ecology or Biology

• Knowledge of national and international environmental legislation, sufficient to provide robust advice on the Danish regulatory environmental assessment and approval process

• Experience managing external environmental consultants to meet contractual requirements and deliver a product

• Experience communicating with regulatory authorities, multi-disciplinary project teams, peers and stakeholders

• Strong organisational, time management, analytical, problem solving, oral and written communication and interpersonal skills

• Excellent computer skills, with proficiency in Word, Excel and PowerPoint

• Ability to work under limited supervision

• Danish language skills are considered a plus (the working language is English)

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organisation where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total rewards package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 710,250 - 947,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership programme participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organisational needs, and market alignment.

Would you like to help shape better energy?

For any questions, you are more than welcome to reach out to HR Recruitment at ep.dk-recruitment@totalenergies.com.

We welcome applications from candidates of all genders and backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement listed.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Chief CCR Operator - Take control of safe operations
jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Application deadline: We review applications as they come in, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Working location: Esbjerg (offshore)

Contract type: Local on local terms

Appetizer

As Chief Central Control Room (CCR) Operator, you will play a crucial role in overseeing our operations on the Danish continental shelf. This position offers experienced professionals extensive site operations experience, contributing to the optimization and safety of our high-complexity assets. You will also help develop the next generation of control room operators through structured training, coaching and competency development. Your work will directly impact our production efficiency and safety standards, helping us achieve our ambitious targets.

Activities

Key Responsibilities

As Chief CCR Operator, you will oversee the start-up, shutdown, optimization and monitoring of our facilities, ensuring operations align with production plans. You will act as first responder to emergencies, maintain accurate logs and ensure smooth handovers. Developing team competencies, fostering continuous improvement and maintaining effective communication with onshore teams will be key. You will collaborate with other interfaces to ensure operational efficiency, contribute to implementing new management systems, and drive improvements in safety, operational efficiency and operating costs (OPEX) to meet Group standards.

Your tasks will include:

• Operating the facilities (start-up, shutdown, optimization, monitoring) within the defined design envelopes and production plans

• Triggering the first response to emergency situations

• Ensuring high-quality handovers and logbook management

• Keeping an overview of and logging all activities on the installation (personnel on board, site location, type of work, hours, Permits to Work, etc.)

• Applying inhibitions as required and acting as Inhibition Authority, including first approval of Inhibit Certificates

• Contributing to the safety performance of the site

• Communicating effectively with staff in the field

• Communicating potential impacts on daily forecasted production to DOCC

• Executing all duties in compliance with company rules and best practices

• Coordinating the daily tasks in the Central Control Room under guidance from the Production Supervisor

• Ensuring that CCR Operators are trained and exposed to all the various tasks in the control room

Candidate Profile

It is important that you possess a safety mindset and approach the job with a strong understanding of the business and people. You thrive in a highly independent and visible position in a free and dynamic working environment. You have an analytical and detail-focused mindset, a clear ability to manage emergency situations, and excellent interpersonal and communication skills, combining a holistic business view with concrete initiatives. You are a strong team player who builds relationships and works constructively with others to achieve shared business goals.

Your background

• You have a technical background with additional Oil & Gas training.

• You have a minimum of 5 years’ experience as CCR Operator.

• You have good leadership and management experience, with the ability to organize, lead and motivate a large team of staff and contractors from different cultures and levels of education.

• You communicate effectively and have a clear focus on Health, Safety and Environment (HSE).

• You are fluent in English.

Due to the nature of this role, employment is contingent on obtaining security clearance from PET (the Danish Security and Intelligence Service). We will initiate this process upon your appointment.

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 453,000 to 604,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

jobs.occupation: Geoscientist - Safer wells through better data
jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Application deadline: 03-12-2026

Working location: Esbjerg

Contract type: Local

Appetizer

We are seeking a dedicated Geoscientist to join our team at a leading offshore operator in Denmark. This role offers high visibility within our active drilling, intervention, workover and abandonment campaigns, focusing on mature and high complexity assets. Exposure to operations and challenges in long horizontal, extended reach wells is assured.

Activities

Key responsibilities

As a Geoscientist specializing in subsurface operations, your primary responsibility will be to support planning, execution and close-out of well delivery, workover and abandonment operations. You will plan, prepare, supervise and interpret LWD, open-hole and cased-hole wireline log data, ensuring that the data acquired is of high quality and directly supports operational decisions and asset objectives.

You will join the Subsurface Well Delivery team, a multidisciplinary group of petrophysicists and geologists. Working closely with the drilling and subsurface study teams, you will ensure the optimal design and follow-up of data acquisition plans, safeguarding the quality of the data acquired.

Your tasks will include:

• Coordinating with stakeholders (2G&R, Drilling, Well Services and Decommissioning) to align subsurface inputs, priorities and timelines across well delivery, workovers, interventions and abandonments. This may occasionally involve unsocial hours.

• Identifying, justifying and formulating data acquisition plans and operational programs, in coordination with other teams and external vendors, to inform operational decisions and mitigate risk.

• Planning, preparing, supervising and interpreting LWD, open-hole and cased-hole wireline logging operations and data.

• Assisting with pore pressure prediction and integration of geomechanical data into operational plans.

• Outlining geosteering strategy and supporting well placement optimization in conjunction with operations geologists and well-site geologists.

• Documenting lessons learned, evaluating vendor performance, and maintaining consistent data deliverables and interpretation standards.

• Providing petrophysical input to the identification and planning of production optimization and infill well opportunities.

• Maintaining strong relations with both internal and external stakeholders.

• Contributing to other activities in the team as required.

Candidate Profile

What you bring

It is important that you possess a safety mindset. You have strong interpersonal skills and experience from well operations or well delivery, and you are able to recognize and adapt to integration requirements with your subsurface 2G&R, driller and well engineering peers. You are a team and peer relationship builder with strong spoken, written and presentation skills. We value a collaborative colleague who is willing to cooperate across teams and departments to achieve shared business goals.

Your background

• You hold an MSc in Petroleum Engineering, Geophysics or Petroleum Geology.

• You must demonstrate strong geological understanding, competency, or willingness to develop it.

• You have more than 6 years of relevant experience.

• You have experience in acquisition and interpretation of wireline and LWD open-hole logs and cased-hole logging of horizontal wellbores.

• You have previous experience with subsurface operations planning and execution.

• Prior exposure to geosteering in carbonates is desirable, as is knowledge of pore pressure prediction, geomechanics, well interventions and abandonment.

• Proficiency with Geolog, Techlog, and Petrel.

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

**Job Description Summary

**Activities contributing to the design, development, and lifecycle support of products, solutions, and systems. Includes activities linked to new product development and technical improvement of existing products and components. The role impacts approaches, projects, and programs within the functional area and supports both R&D and manufacturing activities. Impacts quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team. Has significant input into technical priorities and engineering decisions. Guided by professional practices and policies while requiring a high level of operational judgment.

**Job Description

****Roles and Responsibilities

**

• Responsible for electronic hardware design and engineering, including designing, developing, modifying, and evaluating electronic circuits, assemblies, and subsystems for medical devices and other hardware systems. Common skill sets include Power Electronics, Analog, Digital, Mixed Signal, Power Management, Battery Systems, DC/DC Converters, Microcontrollers, and Embedded Hardware.

• Develop specialized knowledge within the power electronics discipline and serve as a technical resource within the team. Maintain awareness of the latest technical developments and contribute to engineering strategy, best practices, and technology decisions.

• Apply technical expertise to design robust, reliable, and manufacturable electronic solutions. Perform circuit analysis, hardware debugging, verification testing, root cause investigations, and evaluation of design alternatives.

• Support products throughout their lifecycle, including manufacturing support, production issue resolution, component obsolescence management, design improvements, and implementation of engineering changes.

• Use judgment to solve moderately complex technical problems across product development, manufacturing, quality, and supplier interactions. Take a practical and data-driven approach to identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

• Participate in Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) activities, including impact assessments, technical documentation, verification planning, and implementation of design changes.

• Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information and works across functions to build consensus and drive technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Experience in Engineering/Technology and Electronic Hardware knowledge level is comparable to a Master's degree from an university or college (or equivalent relevant experience).

• Strong background in electronic hardware development with demonstrated experience in power electronics.

• Working knowledge of analog and digital electronics and the integration of complete electronic systems.

• Experience with laboratory testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and verification of electronic hardware.

• Experience supporting manufacturing activities, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and implementation of hardware improvements.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Strong experience with power electronics, power supplies, power management, battery-powered products, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting products in production environments and working with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and suppliers to resolve technical issues.

• Familiarity with ECR/ECO processes, design transfer, production launch, and lifecycle management activities.

• Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Established project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

You will work alongside our senior platform engineers on our Kubernetes-native stack, taking ownership of real infrastructure from early on. This is a role where you'll learn by building: our environment is modern and opinionated, and you'll be running production infrastructure for financial institutions, not sandbox projects.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain our AWS infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, starting with well-scoped modules and growing into larger architectural work.

• Kubernetes Operations: Support our EKS clusters and a rapidly growing microservices environment (NestJS backend), handling deployments, troubleshooting, and day-to-day cluster health.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

• GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

• Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Foundations: 1–3 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

• CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

• IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

• Observability: DataDog

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

At Weibel, we develop and deliver advanced radar systems to customers across the world. Our technology is recognized for its exceptional precision, and continued demand for our systems has driven significant growth and international expansion in recent years.

With that growth comes a need to strengthen how we tell our story. We are therefore looking for an experienced Communications Manager who can help sharpen our corporate voice, increase our international visibility and turn our technology, people and ambitions into compelling stories for the audiences that matter.

You will join our Marketing & Communications team and have a real opportunity to shape both the role and the way we work with corporate communications going forward.

Shape our corporate voice and international position

As Communications Manager, you will play a central role in shaping how Weibel communicates and positions itself towards media, authorities, partners, current and future employees and other key stakeholders.

The role combines strategic communications judgement with hands-on execution. You will advise senior leadership on positioning, identify and develop stories worth telling and turn complex technology, business developments and strategic priorities into clear and compelling communication.

A key focus will be to strengthen our proactive approach to PR and build Weibel’s visibility in Denmark and internationally. You will develop relevant media relationships and help position Weibel, our CEO and other spokespeople in the conversations that matter.

You will report to our Director of Marketing & Communications and work across the organization to build a distinctive corporate voice and a more proactive communications approach.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Driving Weibel’s corporate communications and PR across Denmark and key international markets, building media relationships and proactively identifying and pitching relevant stories.

• Advising senior leaders and spokespeople on positioning and external communication and translating complex subjects into clear and compelling narratives.

• Owning Weibel’s corporate LinkedIn presence, from editorial planning and content creation to publishing and follow-up.

• Developing Weibel’s corporate voice and brand, ensuring a consistent tone of voice and visual identity across channels.

• Driving internal communication in collaboration with HR and leaders, helping colleagues understand our direction and priorities.

• Owning the editorial development of Weibel’s corporate website, ensuring that content reflects our position, purpose and values.

Your profile

You are an experienced communications professional with strong editorial judgement, a sharp eye for a good story and the confidence to advise senior stakeholders. You know how to turn complex technology, business developments and strategic priorities into clear and compelling communication, and you are equally comfortable setting direction and producing high-quality content yourself.

You thrive in an international environment where technology, business and external affairs intersect, and where communication requires curiosity, sound judgement and integrity. Experience from defense, government, B2G or another regulated and stakeholder-intensive environment will be an advantage.

We imagine that you bring:

• Relevant experience from corporate communications, PR, government communications or journalism

• Strong experience with media relations, corporate positioning and proactive storytelling

• The ability to advise senior stakeholders and develop compelling narratives around complex subjects

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English

• Experience developing content across corporate channels, including LinkedIn and digital platforms

Contact and application

Please apply through our website using the Apply button.

If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Patricia Brusgaard, Director of Marketing and Communications, at +45 31 46 78 23 or PABR@weibel.dk.

The deadline for applications is December 7, 2026, and we expect to conduct interviews during weeks 49 and 50.

Please note that this position requires a criminal record with no remarks and the ability to obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the‑art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in‑house production and advanced technological development.

Shaping the Future of Airline Retailing

Are you passionate about cutting-edge digital back-end solutions within the Offer & Order domain and want to be at the heart of product development and operations at SAS? Do you have a talent for connecting business needs with digital capabilities turning ideas into scalable solutions?

Join our team and shape the future of airline retailing at SAS. As Solution Architect you will be responsible for the architecture of the back-end commercial Offer & Order solutions that power all our sales channels. This role is pivotal in SAS´s digital journey toward modern airline retailing, leveraging data and AI capabilities to create smarter commercial solutions and enhanced customer experiences.

Challenges you will work on:

In this exciting and dynamic role, you will oversee and be accountable for the architecture of digital back-end services within the Offer & Order domain balancing development initiatives, security, technology and partner strategy for all external and internal services in the domain, such as:

• Lead the solution architecture of strategic commercial transformation initiatives, including AI-enabled Dynamic Pricing optimization, and next-generation retailing capabilities, from concept through implementation

• Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders, translating commercial strategy into scalable digital capabilities and solution architecture

• Lead the solution architecture roadmap and documentation, ensuring alignment with the strategic direction, including future Offer generation and the transition to native Order management (IATA ONE Order)

• Balance and integrate modern technologies with legacy systems to deliver scalable, resilient, and future-proof solutions

• Work closely with Digital Service Owners, internal teams as well as external partners and vendors to ensure alignment, integration and successful delivery of Offer & Order solution components.

• Stay ahead of aviation, retailing and technology trends including agentic commerce, bringing innovation and actionable insights into SAS´s architectural strategy

The Team

As Solution Architect Offer & Order in the Offer & Order Solutions team, SAS Digital &IT, you will join a diverse and high-performing team contributing with our different areas of expertise. We work closely with our colleagues within IT, Commercial, Revenue Management/Pricing, Distribution, and external technology partners. We value a collaborative and forward-thinking environment with a commitment to provide customer value.

To be successful we believe you have

• 5+ years’ experience in solution architecture, software development or technical ownership within airline commercial ecosystems e.g. PSS, Shopping, Revenue Management, Distribution/NDC

• Solid experience in designing, building and evolving complex architectures and integrations

• Experience with API design, AI-enabled solutions and data platforms

• A structured, analytical mindset with strategic thinking and a strong drive to achieve results

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders

• Tech-savvy with experience or a strong interest in leveraging AI technologies, automation, and data-driven capabilities to enhance digital products, services, and engineering practices

• Education within Computer Science, IT or Engineering

Why SAS?

At SAS, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of airline retailing working with modern cloud platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, and industry-leading Offer & Order technologies in a highly collaborative environment. Working with us also comes with a range of valuable benefits. You’ll enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS, access to various health and wellness initiatives and attractive employee discounts on brands, transport, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals. We also offer a pre-tax benefit scheme covering mobile phones, computers, internet, massage, and public transport, as well as discounts on healthcare services and a competitive pension scheme.

Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

jobs.occupation: Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our Commercial Excellence team as Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights.

At DFDS, we are strengthening how we use pricing, customer data and commercial insights to improve profitability, support growth and create greater value for our customers.

As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will drive the development of pricing capabilities, help establish a stronger customer data foundation and turn commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business.

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, which works across DFDS to enable more efficient, data-driven and profitable commercial operations. Through common tools, processes and insights, we help strengthen commercial performance while supporting local business ownership and flexibility.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.

About The Role As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will own and drive DFDS' pricing excellence and commercial insights agenda across a complex, international business.

This is a highly strategic role focused on strengthening pricing capabilities, improving commercial decision-making, and unlocking value from customer and commercial data. Working across business units and functions, you will lead key transformation initiatives, establish scalable frameworks and best practices, and drive the adoption of tools, processes, and data-driven ways of working.

Operating in a highly decentralized organisation, you will balance the implementation of common standards and governance with the need for local ownership and commercial flexibility.

Pricing Excellence and Commercial Insights is an area of increasing strategic importance and executive attention. You will play a key role in elevating its maturity and impact, working closely with Commercial leadership, Data & Technology, Customer Engagement, Tender Management, and Tools & Processes to deliver measurable business value.

**Key priorities

**

• Drive the Pricing Excellence strategy across business units, establishing governance, standards and best practices while enabling local flexibility

• Own the business vision and roadmap for our pricing platform, ensuring continuous development, adoption and value creation

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

• Build and mature Commercial Insights capabilities, transforming data into actionable recommendations and commercial decision support

• Shape the long-term strategy for our customer data foundation in partnership with Data & Technology

• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce revenue leakage through analytics, automation and AI

• Facilitate alignment, collaboration and knowledge sharing across business units and senior stakeholders

• Translate complex data and insights into clear recommendations for management and commercial leadership

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built through diverse perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

With this in mind, we think that you are a strategic and commercially minded professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning insights into action. You combine strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders, challenge existing ways of working and drive change across a matrix organisation.

You thrive at the intersection of business, data and technology and are motivated by creating tangible commercial impact through pricing excellence, customer insights and continuous improvement.

We think the ideal person for this position will bring the following:

• 5+ years of relevant experience within Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Revenue Management, Strategy, Management Consulting, Business Development, Finance, Analytics or a related field

• A strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority

• Experience operating in complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• A strategic mindset combined with the ability to translate ideas and opportunities into practical solutions and business outcomes

• Experience working with commercial tools and platforms such as CRM, pricing, CPQ, contract management or business intelligence solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations

• Interest in leveraging data, automation and AI to improve commercial performance and decision-making

• The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and confidently to both operational teams and senior stakeholders

• A curiosity for understanding customers, commercial processes and business drivers, combined with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Working at DFDS

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

**Help Write Our Next Chapter

**As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

**What Makes You Shine

**You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

**We would love to hear from you if you bring:

**

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

**Crafting What’s Next, Together

**You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

**The Impact You Will Make

**Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

**The Additional Sparkle

**You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

**Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

**If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Let’s Craft the Incredible

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

At AGC Biologics, you’ll join a fast-growing biopharmaceutical company where quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. As an Electrical/Automation Technician in our Equipment Maintenance team, you’ll be a key contributor in maintaining and improving manufacturing and utility systems—directly supporting life-changing therapies for patients worldwide.

In this role, your work directly impacts our ability to deliver high-quality biopharmaceuticals on time—and positions you at the heart of a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your expertise helps power life-changing therapies.

**About The Team

**The Equipment Maintenance team in Engineering comprises 8 dedicated technicians with a strong focus on personal development, collaboration, and high professional standards. We operate with a flat structure where every contribution matters and decisions are made collaboratively. Our culture emphasizes ownership, continuous learning, and mutual support. We work closely together to maintain critical production equipment and promote a safe, innovative, and engaging work environment.

**About The Role

**As an Electrician in our Equipment Maintenance team, you will play a critical role within Engineering by ensuring the reliability and performance of all electrical systems that keep our biopharmaceutical production equipment running around the clock. You will take technical ownership of complex electrical systems and support automation tasks as needed. You will be the team’s key resource when it comes to troubleshooting critical alarms, executing preventive and corrective maintenance, and driving continuous improvements in our electrical infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead troubleshooting of electrical faults in production and utility equipment, including motors, control panels, and distribution systems

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on legacy and modern equipment, ensuring maximum uptime

• Use CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to plan, execute, and document work orders accurately and on time

• Ensure full GMP-compliant documentation for all maintenance activities

• Support commissioning of new electrical installations and upgrades

• Identify and implement optimizations to improve equipment performance, safety, and energy efficiency

• Participate in the on-call and shift rotation to support 24/7 production operations

**Your Qualifications

**We are looking for a hands-on technician with strong expertise in electrical systems, a structured approach to maintenance, and a commitment to high-quality standards.

**Ideally, You Must Have The Following Qualifications

**

• Completed education as an Industrial Electrician or equivalent (e.g., “Elektriker med erfaring fra industri eller procesanlæg”)

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in electrical troubleshooting and maintenance

• Strong understanding of industrial power systems, motor control, switchboards, and safety standards

• Practical knowledge of control panels, frequency converters, and field-level electrical components

• Familiarity with CMMS systems for maintenance planning and execution

• Experience working in structured, regulated environments—ideally within GMP or similar standards

• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team

The following qualifications will further strengthen your application, but are not essential:

• Familiarity with automation systems and PLC fault tracing (e.g., Siemens S7/TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley)

• Basic understanding of HMI/SCADA systems and distributed control concepts

• Able to communicate effectively in both Danish and English

Join Site MSAT and help improve the performance of established vaccine manufacturing processes.

We are looking for a Senior Bioprocess Engineer who will combine process understanding, manufacturing data and engineering insight to deliver measurable improvements in yield, cycle time, capacity and robustness across our Rabies and TBE processes at the BNK site.

**About The Role

**As our Senior Bioprocess Engineer, you will drive process optimization and continuous improvement throughout the lifecycle of our vaccine processes.

You will use data, scientific understanding and engineering methods to identify performance gaps, understand sources of variability and translate opportunities into practical, sustainable changes. Working closely with

Manufacturing and technical functions, you will lead improvement initiatives from problem definition and analysis through testing, implementation and verification of benefits. Equipment knowledge will be important where equipment–process interactions affect performance, but the focus of the role is the process and its outcomes.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Analyse process performance using continued process verification data, statistics and data visualisation.

• Lead improvements in yield, cycle time, throughput, capacity and process robustness.

• Apply structured problem solving and Lean methods to identify root causes and resolve process challenges.

• Build process understanding through manufacturing data, scientific knowledge and shop-floor insights.

• Design engineering studies, trials and scale-down models to evaluate process improvements.

• Translate findings into recommendations, business cases and implementation plans with measurable outcomes.

• Implement and sustain improvements through risk assessment, change control, validation and updated control strategies.

• Provide technical expertise for complex deviations, investigations and CAPAs.

• Support technology transfer, scale-up, process introduction and requirements for equipment, automation and digital solutions.

• Collaborate across Manufacturing, technical and quality functions, Global MSAT and external partners.

**What You Bring

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biochemical, chemical, bioprocess, pharmaceutical engineering or a related discipline.

• Experience in process optimisation, manufacturing science, process engineering or continuous improvement within GMP biopharmaceutical manufacturing, preferably vaccines or biologics.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including manufacturing-data analysis, process trending and statistical methods.

• A proven ability to improve yield, cycle time, capacity, process robustness or cost efficiency.

• A solid understanding of bioprocess unit operations and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of GMP, validation, change control, investigations, risk management and data integrity.

• A collaborative, pragmatic approach and the ability to turn technical insights into clear recommendations and lead cross-functional improvements.

• Experience with downstream processing, Lean, bottleneck analysis, design of experiments, scale-down models, technology transfer or scale-up is an advantage.

Why join us?

You will join a collaborative Site MSAT team with the opportunity to shape how process optimisation is delivered for established vaccine products.

Your work will turn manufacturing data and process knowledge into tangible improvements that strengthen product quality, process capability and reliable supply.

The role offers meaningful technical ownership, close access to commercial operations and the freedom to combine scientific thinking with practical engineering solutions.
